problem.heading: Traveling somewhere new should feel exciting — not uncertain.
problem.lede: In a new country, small things become bigger. If you don't speak Uzbek or Russian, everyday decisions quietly rely on someone else.
problem.p1: When you shop at a bazaar or order in a teahouse, a translator or guide becomes your voice. But if you don't know local market prices, you can't check whether the number you're quoted matches what locals pay. That creates an information imbalance — and it doesn't take much for a 10,000 UZS item to start sounding like 20,000 UZS.
problem.p2: FairGuide is designed to close that gap: verified people you can check in advance, and reference price information that helps you make better-informed decisions.
problem.nuance: We're not suggesting that guides or businesses cheat travelers. Prices naturally vary by store, location and season. FairGuide simply provides reference information where reliable data exists — so decisions are informed, not assumed.
problem.imageAlt: A tourist and a local translator at a bazaar stall in Uzbekistan, looking at a handmade product and its price

faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.sub: What travelers usually ask before they start.

items.a: No. FairGuide is a platform. It connects you with verified local guides, translators and — in the future — student volunteers and host families. You choose who you work with and what you book.

items.q: How does the price scanner work?
items.a: You scan a barcode, a product or a price tag. FairGuide compares the result with available reference prices from reliable data sources and shows a clear transparency indicator. It is reference information, not a judgment on any seller.
Guides and translators go through profile verification, identity checks and a review system. Ratings and feedback from real trips keep the ecosystem honest over time.
The volunteer program is a planned feature. We are preparing the student partnership, certificates and verification workflow — the join form collects early interest.
The platform is available in English, Uzbek, Russian, Turkish and Chinese — and it is built so more languages can be added easily.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.body:
FairGuide respects your privacy. We collect only the information needed to provide the service: account details, communication content, and trip information.

We never sell personal data. Reference price data is aggregated and anonymized before it is used. You can request access, correction or deletion of your data at any time by writing to privacy@fairguide.uz.

This is a preliminary policy for the public website. Detailed descriptions of data processing will be published before the full platform launch.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.body:
By using the FairGuide website you agree to use it lawfully and in good faith.

Content on this site, including reference prices, is provided for informational purposes only. It is not a guarantee of any transaction and is not a statement about any specific seller.

Features marked as "planned" or "coming soon" are not yet available. We may update these terms from time to time; continued use of the site constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.

For questions about these terms, write to legal@fairguide.uz.
